sentences.text: The genus Lonchodytes was established with the type species Lonchodytes estesi.
This animal is classified within the parent group Aequornithes.
Cladistic analysis suggests Lonchodytes is more closely related to Procellariiformes, or tubenoses, than to other bird orders.
Researchers generally believe Lonchodytes is closely related to, or part of a clade with, other higher waterbirds like penguins.
The genus Lonchodytes existed from 72.2 to 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian.
Lonchodytes likely lived during the Maastrichtian stage, approximately 70 million years ago.
It is debated whether the fossils found in the Lance Creek Formation are in situ or reworked from younger Danian deposits.
